sources.title: Unlocking Patient Privacy: A New Open-Source Portuguese PII Model Hits ...
sources.snippet: Handling sensitive health records is a delicate balancing act. You need the data to flow for research and treatment, but you cannot expose Personally Identifiable Information (PII). The latest addition to the Modelers.cn platform tackles this specific headache for Portuguese-speaking regions: the OpenMed-PII-Portuguese-ClinicalBGE-Large-568M-v1.
